description: A visibility in statute miles as a report writes it: the reportable value at or below it, never above, from the Federal Meteorological Handbook No. 1 (FCM-H1-2019), Table 6-1, "Reportable Visibility Values" (0, 1/16, 1/8, 3/16, 1/4, 5/16, 3/8, 1/2, 5/8, 3/4, 7/8, 1, then eighths to 2, quarters to 3, whole miles to 15, every 5 past that), as FAA JO 7900.5E carries it.
